HDRI Haven (now Poly Haven) panoramas, as redistributed in google/filament (third_party/environments).
Source: https://github.com/google/filament/tree/main/third_party/environments (CC0.html, URL.txt -> https://hdrihaven.com/),
fetched October 10, 2026. License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0). No attribution required.
Files: lightroom_14b.hdr (studio, used for glass and metal reflections), venetian_crossroads_2k.hdr (street, the day sky) and the_sky_is_on_fire_2k.hdr (dusk, the night-preset sky).
